release_authority: Review only. No merge, deployment, Production migration or assignment activation.
cause_root: Before fix, JS used occurred_at <= inbound timestamp and no complete tie-break; capture RPC used the current conversation head without that cutoff. An out-of-order delivery deterministically failed the CAS with P0001/social_context_changed_requires_review.

Transport insertion and routing were separate. The snapshot worker could independently set transport processed/clear last_error after a failed capture; there was no durable, separate commercial status.
The production diagnosis established the same P0001 signature before PR164. This PR does not roll back PR164 or retroactively process those events.

design.selector: Both JS and capture invoke read_social_route_context_v1. Current/CAS head and as-of historical context are separate. Total descending order: occurred_at, created_at, UUID id; excludes HUMAN_REVIEW exactly as before.
design.current_intent: Current head protects durable OWNER and compare-and-swap; historical context is NOT a concurrency token.
design.late_policy: A chronologically late message creates one HUMAN_REVIEW route and review_required receipt; no specialist inbound, model, response or assignment. Current OWNER is not overwritten.
design.receipt: AFTER INSERT trigger atomically seeds pending with eligible transport. Snapshot state remains independent. RPC capture atomically writes route+specialist inbound+receipt completion. Failure writes terminal allowlisted review.
design.retry: begin counts webhook deliveries. Only exact stale-CAS reason gets <=3 DB-only re-read/reclassification attempts before any remote effect. No automatic retry after unknown outcome. Four Respond deliveries reuse one decision or terminal review. Terminal review never automatically reopens.
design.compatibility: Existing route/provider-message dedupe retained. Redelivery of pre-rollout transport links existing decision or creates one preexisting_transport_requires_review without replay. No sweep/backfill.
design.visibility: Existing admin-only /social-routing and API: transport received, snapshot status, routing status, safe reason/SQLSTATE/stage/RPC, attempts/timestamps, operational queue owner and Inbox link when RESPOND_IO_WORKSPACE_ID is configured. Paginated oldest-first to retain old and fresh reviews. Read-only even with Social OFF.
design.effects: No assignment, ACK, sender, appointment, retry scheduler or snapshot-worker business logic changes. Existing exclusive lane guards, outbound uniqueness and effect reservation RPCs retained.

schema.security: RLS ON; no anon/authenticated privileges; service_role SELECT only on receipts, EXECUTE on narrow SECURITY DEFINER RPCs with empty search_path. Trigger execution is not exposed as RPC.
schema.rollback: supabase/rollback/social_capture_failsafe_empty_only.sql restores the original capture function verbatim and refuses any receipts. No CASCADE/no customer deletion. After use retain evidence/schema; any application rollback needs separate approval and review of mixed workers.

rollout_pre_go: Review this PR and explicit late-message-to-human policy.
Authorize production migration separately; migration/postcheck before application release. Never run mass pending migrations.
Read back effective flags; no changes to Social/Recovery/SLA/handoff URL or Approved Materials from this PR.
Verify admin queue access and existing RESPOND_IO_WORKSPACE_ID Inbox integration.
Drain old webhook workers or account for mixed-version window: old code cannot seed receipts for new events until rollout; do not claim that window repaired.
No retrospective customer replay, contact assignment or model test.
Observe one eligible receipt per provider message, route exclusivity, safe pending/review and zero duplicate effects after separately authorized deploy.
residual_risks: Late events require human review and may increase queue volume; this is deliberate fail-closed handling, not automatic replay.
Visible/admin-owned work is not evidence of human acknowledgment or resolution. Queue is read-only; no new CRM/assignment/closing workflow.
Inbox navigation depends on existing workspace configuration; missing configuration must block production acceptance of actionable review.
A DB outage can prevent review completion; atomic transport/receipt, when committed, remains pending and visible after service recovers.
Total-order selection does not prove atomicity of external Respond assignment; that remains separate and disabled.
Production SQL and deployment remain unapproved/unperformed; DEV DB/RPC + intercepted transport is not real customer delivery.
